prompt: Leave the voicemail Dad leaves after hearing about your promotion. He is very proud. He will not say that.
response:

Hey. It's me. Your mother told me to call. Something about... she wrote it down... *[paper rustling]* ...right, the job thing. The big one. So. *[long pause]*

Anyway. I'm at the store, they got that—doesn't matter. *[clears throat]* Your mother wants to know when you're coming for dinner. Don't make it about you, she just... we got a lot of food. Too much. Someone should eat it.

So. Yeah. Okay.
